Question 23 [4 marks]: Explain how the recognition of ONE human right has developed over time.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Demonstrates a clear understanding of how ONE human right has developed over time
3 marks: Demonstrates some understanding of how ONE human right has developed over time
2 marks: Makes a statement about how ONE human right has developed over time
1 marks: Makes a general statement about human rights

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The right to education has been recognised over time through international and domestic law. During the 19th century, the Industrial Revolution led to improved access to basic education to enhance the skills of workers. In the 20th century, the international community responded by including the right to elementary education in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The right to education has been further developed in New South Wales through the Education Act 1990 which requires students to remain in education until they are 17 years old.
